❣️ A DeFi attacker inflated the price of tokenized Google stock by 7,700 percent — roughly 78 times its real value — and walked away leaving 403,000 dollars of bad debt in a lending protocol.

No candle did this. No direction did this. A pricing oracle accepted a broken number, and every position that trusted it paid.

This is the lesson most traders learn expensively: oracle risk is liquidation risk with a different name. Your stop-loss cannot save you from broken pricing infrastructure. Your position size can — it is the only line of defense that works when the plumbing itself fails.

Size for the failure you cannot predict, not just the chart you can see.

Source, CoinDesk, 1 July 2026.
